title: Patrol
question: What does Nigeria Customs Service Act 2023 section 226 say about patrol?
shortAnswer: Nigeria Customs Service Act 2023 s.226 — Customs officers may patrol highways, enter premises, stop/search vehicles/vessels within customs territory.
legalExplanation:
**Section 226 of the Nigeria Customs Service Act 2023** provides:

Customs officers may patrol highways, enter premises, stop/search vehicles/vessels within customs territory

This provision empowers Nigeria Customs Service Act 2023 officers with specific powers and duties.
